changes: Added ability for burn node cones to show rate of change by changing position from center of the burn node. Regression: you can't nicely go back and forth between the inverted axes but I just need to re-add it soonTM.
Fixed the burn node rate of change axes being incorrect at certain angles.
Added shift left click to set transfer target.
Changed closest approach markers to ONLY display for the Target body when it is set.
Added control button to map mode to swap between map controls and vehicle controls.
Added hotkey for map mode control setting (default tab) and some associated UI.
Used helpers to get more accurate distance strings in Map UI.

Bandaid fixed flight plan and manual thrust toggle accidentally overlapping. There's a few problems with the current KeyAssignment IsActive() code that needs to check against potential collisions and whether we're releasing or pressing to avoid keys getting stuck on while holding modifiers.
Added digital signing assistance file for building, to allow for public deployment of builds that will be signed with RocketWerkz code signature.
Added file processing instructions for building using sign certificates, to ease public build deployment process.
Added batch file execution to deploy build for public (unlisted) repository

Fixed issue where impact with parent causes patch calculation to update the state vector to the impact time instead of it remaining at the patch start time. Which caused all kinds of crazy to happen when you transitions SOI into the patch.
Fixed issue where hovering was not working on a patch that wrapped from a start anomaly > PI to an end anomaly > 0.
Changed log error to an info message when we are hyperbolic in an Infinite SOI for now. Who knows what the future might bring.
Added megameters for distance string outputs to make the gap between kilometers and AU a bit more consistent size-wise.
Gave the map view menu another pass to make it easier to read without lots of resizing.
Changed Ap and Pe markers to be not shown by default on all astronomicals except for the one being followed by the camera.
Added View menu item to turn on/off Ap and Pe markers for all astronomicals.
Moved DrawUi for each Patch from FlightPlan into PAtchedConic class.
Added debug build option to display lambert transfer orbits from the Transfer Planner UI for debugging purposes.
Merging in lighting fixes branch (Might want to clear your graphics settings which were configured for broken lighting)

Genericized quite a bit of common gizmo functionality as well as made it far easier to create new types of gizmos. 'BrickGizmo' survives the genericization due to it having slight differences. It will be converted in another commit SoonTM.
Restructure the TransferPlanner/OrbitalTransfers data classes to rationalize some of the data better.
Adjust brightness of atmosphere, clouds, ocean and exhausts after lighting fixes while still taking into account sun's brightness and color
Fix sunflare turning off when disabling atmosphere rendering
Changed Ap and Pe markers and CelestialInfo readouts for Ap and Pe to be distance from mean radius instead of from the center of the body.
Replaced the old 2D ImGui circle used for denoting SoI of a target with a gizmo that attempts to give it a bit more depth for situational awareness.
Modified the gizmo system to work with different pipelines.
Added a pooling system for gizmos that are 'one off' uses so every astronomical doesn't need a gizmo object.
Fixed the Maneuver UI was being drawn multiple times in the main viewport depending on how many viewports you had open. Now it will only render ONCE to the main view.
Changed the rendering of the patch UI to backwards order so that the overlay from earliest to latest.
Fixed patches UI elements not rendering in other viewports (in addition to the main window).
Fix atmo/cloud settings for the new tonemapper and gamma, remove some magic numbers
Remove leftover use of removed atmosphere brightness magic number in cloud shader
Moved sphere of influence transitions into the inner update loop so that we can potentially transition after each vehicle step.
Added sphere of influence transition checks after off-rails vehicle steps.
Modified FlightPlan to be incrementally updatable. This lets us solve the first patch transition after a step and only solve the full trajectory at the end of an update.
FlightPlan now tracks whether it needs an update internally so it can be dispatched more consistently.
Removed redundant PatchColor from PatchedConic - we now use the underlying Orbit.OrbitLineColor.
Fixed the flight plan color fade-out so it actually works instead of assigning the same value to all patches.
Preserve capture/escape/encounter indices in the hover text.
Fixed quadrant readout for LocalPosition which had broken in the -PI -> PI change.
Added generic Erosion terrain modifier.
Added first pass terrain derivatives generation. For the heightmap itself the normal map is used (which is wrong) - this will be replaced by a separate map in the future.
Added procedural modifier requirement flags. Determines what computations a given modifier needs to function and can influence what previous modifiers in the order stack must compute to support it.
Improved the quality of Earth's normal map and saved as BC5 ATI2.
Removed unused Equals and GetHashCode implementations from ModifierRenderParams.
Added a temporary darker diffuse texture for the Moon which isn't quite as blinding.
Improved the quality of the Moon's normal map.
Moved GenerateMeshHeight.comp, GenerateMeshNormals.comp and MeshPlanetUbo.glsl to TerrainMesh subdirectory.
Moved terrain mesh shader buffers and bindings to a single file MeshDataCommon.glsl.
Added HeightFuncs.glsl containing a function to build the terrain height at a given direction from planet center rather than keeping it local to the GenerateMeshHeight shader.
Removed MeshPlanetUbo.glsl as it was merged into MeshDataCommon.glsl.
